title: semantic-evidence-reviewer return (one review call)
description: A4 of the 2026-10-03 Jev rules (README.md, Jev rules). The caller supplies this schema, because agent frontmatter has no schema field: a workflow passes it to agent({agentType, schema}), which validates the return and fails the call after five invalid attempts; a coordinator validates the return of a single Agent-tool call against it; a Codex caller passes it with codex exec --output-schema. Validation checks the shape, not whether a disposition is right. Per case: final_disposition is the reviewer's own source review; retained_provider_disposition is the advisory provider label exactly as the coordinator supplied it, or null when none was supplied; source_refs cite file:line, the recorded pin or the docs; correction and limits are empty strings when there is nothing to report. skill_path and model are 'unavailable' when the client does not expose them. Every property is required and no other is allowed, as Codex strict output requires.
